wikitext:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[Pokémon movie]]s in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}}. DVD releases are for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 2}}, {{wp|Blu-ray}} releases are for {{wp|Blu-ray Region Code|Blu-ray Region B}} (although they may be playable in other regions), and all releases are {{wp|PAL}}. ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]'' and ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'' have not been released on home video in the United Kingdom. ==Single movie releases== ===''Mewtwo Strikes Back''=== ====Original release==== ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'' was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Warner Home Video}} on October 23, 2000. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are V018020 and S018020. These releases use a 4:3 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK01|Pikachu's Vacation]]'' is also included before the film, and the promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Wizards Promo|Mewtwo|3}} was included in early releases. The DVD has English, French, Italian, Dutch, and Portuguese audio; with optional English, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, English for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captions. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras: * Commentary audio track by Director [[Michael Haigney]] and Producer [[Norman J. Grossfeld]] * [[The Story of Mewtwo's Origin]] (first two minutes of ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'') * Music video for {{wp|M2M (band)|M2M}}'s "{{wp|Don't Say You Love Me (M2M song)|Don't Say You Love Me}}" (the movie's ending theme) * Theatrical trailer of the movie * Preview of ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'' * "Ash's Journey" * DVD-ROM features ** Pokemon fun facts ** History of the animated series ** History of the video games ** Pokémon Web World ** Nintendo game guides ** special events page ** Pokémon webcards ** Poké-patterns ** Pokémon posters The VHS release includes [[The Story of Mewtwo's Origin]] (the first two minutes of ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'') added to the beginning of the movie and the preview for ''[[M02|The Power of One]]''. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kanto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kanto}} |image1=Mewtwo Strikes Back UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Mewtwo Strikes Back DVD Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover |image3=Mewtwo Strikes Back UK 2009 DVD Cover.png |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover (with Irish "PG" classification) }} ====Re-release==== ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'' was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the ''Pokémon Movie Collection''. The DVD was also included in early copies of ''[[M20|Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!]]''. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kanto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kanto}} |image1=Pokémon The First Movie DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (Manga Entertainment) |image2=Pokémon The First Movie BR UK.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Blu-ray cover }} ===''The Power of One''=== ====Original release==== {{incomplete|section|needs=VHS aspect ratio}} ''[[M02|Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One]]'' was released in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. It was released on VHS on March 19, 2001, with the catalogue number S018620, and on DVD on May 14, 2001 with the catalogue number D018620. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK04|Pikachu's Rescue Adventure]]'' is included before the film, and the promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Wizards Promo|Pikachu|27}} was included in early releases. The DVD is a double-sided disc that has English, French, and Dutch audio on Side A and English, German, and Italian audio on Side B; with optional English, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Arabic, English for the hearing impaired, German for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captioning. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras: * Musical performances from the [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 (soundtrack)|Pokémon the Movie 2000 soundtrack]] **"They Don't Understand" by {{wp|Dream Street}} **"Story Of" and performance by Alysha Antonino **"Pokémon World" by {{wp|Youngstown (band)|Youngstown}} featuring {{wp|Nobody's Angel}} **Making of the soundtrack * Theatrical trailer of the movie * Theatrical trailer of ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]'' The VHS release has the {{wp|Tom and Jerry}} short ''Polka-Dot Puss'' play before ''The Video Standards Council'' classification bumper, and includes the preview for ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. The movie was re-released in 2007 for {{wp|Woolworths Group|Woolworths}}' "Worth it!" budget range. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Orange}} |border={{colorschemedark|Orange}} |image1=The Power of One UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=The Power of One DVD Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover |image3=The Power of One DVD Region 2 Woolworths.png |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover (Woolworths budget release) }} ====Re-release==== ''[[M02|Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One]]'' was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the ''Pokémon Movie Collection''. {{MerchGallery |image1=Pokémon the Movie 2000 DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover |image2=Pokémon the Movie 2000 BR UK.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Blu-ray cover }} ===''Spell of the Unown: Entei''=== ====Original release==== {{incomplete|section|needs=VHS aspect ratio}} ''[[M03|Pokémon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown: Entei]]'' was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Warner Home Video}} on October 6, 2001. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are S021101 and D021251. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'' is included before the film, and although no bonuses were added in early releases, some retailers offered a promotion where customers would obtain the promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Wizards Promo|Unown J|38}} and a {{DL|List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 2)|Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation}} VHS with the purchase of the VHS or DVD. The DVD is a double-sided disc that has English, French, and Dutch audio on Side A and Italian, Greek, and Hebew audio on Side B; with optional English, Dutch, French, Greek, Italian, Hebrew, English for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captioning. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras: * [[Pokérap GS]] (Johto Pokérap) * Making of "[[To Know the Unknown]]" * What the Filmmakers Say (Commentary audio track) * Theatrical trailer of the movie * Little Known Unown Facts! {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon 3 The Movie UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Pokémon 3 The Movie DVD Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover |image3=Pokémon 3 The Movie DVD Region 2 alternate.png |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover (with Irish "G" classification) }} ====Re-release==== ''[[M02|Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One]]'' was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the ''Pokémon Movie Collection''. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon 3 The Movie DVD Region 2 Manga.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (Manga Entertainment) |image2=Pokémon 3 The Movie BR UK.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Blu-ray cover }} ===''Celebi: The Voice of the Forest''=== ====Original release==== {{incomplete|section|needs=VHS aspect ratio}} ''[[M04|Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]'' was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Miramax}} and {{wp|Buena Vista Home Entertainment}} on October 20, 2003. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are D611536 and D888868. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The DVD has English and Spanish audio; with optional English, English for the hearing impaired, and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD release includes the following extras: * Audio commentary by the actors and producers * Multi-angle animation progression on four scenes * A trivia game * English theatrical trailer * Japanese theatrical trailer and ''[[Pikachu's PikaBoo]]'' trailer * Japanese Theatrical trailer of ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]'' and ''[[Camp Pikachu]]'' None of the Japanese trailers have any subtitles. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon 4Ever UK VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Pokémon 4Ever DVD Region 2 - Buena Vista.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (Buena Vista) }} ====Re-release==== ''[[M04|Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]'' was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on May 9, 2011 by {{wp|StudioCanal}}, with the catalogue number MIROPD2170. The packaging is identical to that of the Buena Vista release, but replaces all mentions of them with StudioCanal branding. The content on the disc is the same as the Buena Vista version, keeping all logos and graphics intact. Within an unknown timeframe, fhe film was re-released again by {{wp|Lionsgate|Lionsgate Home Entertainment}} under the same catalogue number of MIROPD2170. This release is the same as the StudioCanal version but features different logos and copyright information on the back cover. The disc retains StudioCanal branding. The movie was re-released again on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by {{wp|Paramount Home Entertainment}}, following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax. {{MerchGallery |image1=Pokémon 4Ever DVD Region 2 - StudioCanal.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (StudioCanal) |image2=Pokémon 4Ever DVD Region 2 - Paramount.jpg |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (Paramount) }} ===''Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias''=== ====Original release==== {{incomplete|section|needs=Release date, aspect ratio, and catalogue number of release without short}} ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Miramax}} and {{wp|Buena Vista Home Entertainment}} on June 6, 2005. The catalogue number for the DVD is BUA0000501. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}, but in reality only the menus and trailers are shown in this ratio. The movie and special features show in a 4:3 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}, while the ''[[PK11|Camp Pikachu]]'' short shows in a Pillarbox format. The DVD has English, French, and Spanish audio; with optional English, English for the hearing impaired, French, and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD release includes the following extras: * Location scouting in Venice * An animation stages feature (Water Chariot Race, Race Spectators, Crowd on a Bridge, Latias, Defense Mechanism of Alltomare, Wave) * The Characters of "Pokémon Heroes" * The [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK11|Camp Pikachu]]'' * Pokémon Heroes trivia game The movie also has a trailer for ''{{wp|Bionicle: Mask of Light}}'' and ''Pokémon 4Ever'' which play before the main menu. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon Heroes DVD Region 2 - Buena Vista.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (Buena Vista) }} ====Re-release==== ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]'' was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on May 9, 2011 by {{wp|StudioCanal}}, with the catalogue number MIROPD2165. The packaging is identical to that of the Buena Vista release, but replaces all mentions of them with StudioCanal branding. The content on the disc is the same as the Buena Vista version, keeping all logos and graphics intact. The DVD was re-released by StudioCanal in 2016 under the slightly altered catalogue number of MIROPD2165-R2. This version uses a newer print of the film that removes some of the blue tinting, is shown in a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}, replaces logos, and does not contain any special features or the Pikachu short. The movie was re-released again on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by {{wp|Paramount Home Entertainment}}, following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon Heroes DVD Region 2 - StudioCanal.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (2011 StudioCanal) |image2=Pokémon Heroes DVD Region 2 - StudioCanal without short.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (2016 StudioCanal) |image3=Pokémon Heroes DVD Region 2 - Paramount.jpg |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover (Paramount) }} ===''Jirachi: Wish Maker''=== ''[[M06|Jirachi: Wish Maker]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Paramount Home Entertainment}} on October 23, 2006 with the catalogue number PHE9081. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}, but does not include closed captioning despite the packaging saying it does. It also includes the following extras: * Character Gallery * Photo Gallery {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoenn}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoenn}} |image1=Jirachi Wish Maker DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ===''Destiny Deoxys''=== ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Miramax}} and {{wp|StudioCanal}} on April 2, 2012. The catalogue number is MIROPD2186. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The movie was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by {{wp|Paramount Home Entertainment}}, following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoenn}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoenn}} |image1=Destiny Deoxys DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (StudioCanal) |image2=Destiny Deoxys DVD Region 2 - Paramount.jpg |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (Paramount) }} ===''The Rise of Darkrai''=== ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Network Distributing|Network}} on September 29, 2008 with the catalogue number PM7510. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|DP Promo|Darkrai|24}} was included in early releases of the DVD. It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This re-release uses the DVD master used in ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl''. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}} |border={{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}} |image1=The Rise of Darkrai DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ===''Giratina and the Sky Warrior''=== ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}} on November 28, 2011 with the catalogue number 8287463. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. It has English and Norwegian audio, but does not have closed captioning. It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This re-release uses the DVD master used in ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl''. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}} |border={{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}} |image1=Giratina and the Sky Warrior DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ===''Arceus and the Jewel of Life''=== ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}} on November 28, 2011 with the catalogue number 8287464. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. It has English, Norwegian, and Danish audio, but does not have closed captioning. It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This re-release uses the DVD master used in ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl''. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}} |border={{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}} |image1=Arceus and the Jewel of Life DVD Region 2 prerelease.png |size1=x200px |caption1=Tentative cover image
used prior to release |image2=Arceus and the Jewel of Life DVD Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover }} ===''Zoroark: Master of Illusions''=== ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}} on August 29, 2011 with the catalogue number 8284462. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Triumphant|Celebi|3}} was included in early releases of the DVD. It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This re-release uses the DVD master used in ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl''. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}} |border={{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}} |image1=Zoroark Master of Illusions.jpg |size1=x200px |caption1=Tentative cover image
used prior to release |image2=Zoroark Master of Illusions DVD Region 2 prerelease.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Tentative cover image
used prior to release |image3=Zoroark Master of Illusions DVD Region 2.png |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD cover }} ===''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram''=== ''[[M14|White—Victini and Zekrom]]'' and ''[[M14|Black—Victini and Reshiram]]'' was first released on a [[#Pokémon the Movie: 2 Movie Pack|multi-movie set]] by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}} and was later re-issued on a single disc on {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}’s ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Black and White''. The single-disc version seen in the boxset was re-released on September 2, 2019, once again by Manga Entertainment. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. ===''Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice''=== ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]'' was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}} on September 30, 2013 with the catalogue number 8296140. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. It has English and Dutch audio, but does not have closed captioning. The promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|BW Promo|Keldeo|60}} was included in early releases of the DVD. It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on September 2, 2019 by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. This re-release uses the DVD master used in ''Pokémon Movie Collection: Black and White''. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Unova}} |border={{colorschemedark|Unova}} |image1=Keldeo vs the Sword of Justice DVD Region 2 prerelease.png |size1=x200px |caption1=Tentative cover image
used prior to release |image2=Keldeo vs the Sword of Justice DVD Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover }} ===''Genesect and The Legend Awakened''=== ''[[M16|Genesect and The Legend Awakened]]'' was first released on DVD in the UK on the Pokémon Black and White Movie Collection boxset by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. Manga Entertainment released the movie separately for the first time in the UK on September 2, 2019. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. ===''Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction''=== ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'' was first released on DVD in the UK on the Pokémon XY Movie Collection boxset by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. Manga Entertainment released the movie separately for the first time in the UK on September 2, 2019. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. ===''Hoopa and the Clash of Ages''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Blu-Ray Catalogue number}} ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'' was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} on October 24, 2016. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The DVD's product number is MANG5805. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kalos}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kalos}} |image1=Hoopa and the Clash of Ages DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover |image2=Hoopa and the Clash of Ages BR Region 2.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Blu-ray cover }} ===''Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Catalogue number}} ''[[M19|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]'' was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} on May 15, 2017. This release uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kalos}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kalos}} |image1=Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover |image2=Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel BR UK.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Blu-ray cover }} ===''Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=DVD Catalogue number}} ''[[M20|Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!]]'' was released in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} on DVD on February 12, 2018 and was released on Blu-ray in a Steelbook case on April 30, 2018. Both releases use a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The Steelbook’s catalogue number is MANB8853. Two versions of the DVD release were available; one included a bonus disc featuring ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'', while the other did not. The Blu-Ray Steelbook version is no longer in print. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Alola}} |border={{colorschemedark|Alola}} |image1=I Choose You DVD Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover |image2=I Choose You DVD Region 2 bonus disc.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (with bonus disc) |image3=I Choose You BR UK.png |size3=x200px |caption3=Blu-ray Steelbook cover }} ===''Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=DVD Catalogue number.}} ''[[M21|Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us]]'' was released in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} on DVD and Blu-Ray on February 18, 2019. Both versions use a 16:9 aspect ratio. The Blu-Ray’s catalogue number is MANB6725. The Blu-Ray version is a Collector's Edition, including a poster and 4 art cards, and was released in a cardboard sleeve. ==Multi-movie releases== ===Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes=== The Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes Blu-ray was distributed by {{wp|StudioCanal}} in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 2, 2012 with the catalogue number MIROPBD2425. It contains a single disc with both movies: ''[[M04|Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]'' and ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]''. This release uses a 1.85:1 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. It does not include any special features, despite the packaging claiming to contain them. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon 4Ever Pokémon Heroes BR.png |size1=x200px |caption1=Blu-ray cover }} ===Pokémon the Movie: 2 Movie Pack=== The Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram / White—Victini and Zekrom 2 Movie Pack is a multi-movie DVD set released in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Universal Studios Home Entertainment|Universal Pictures UK}}. It was released in the United Kingdom on April 9, 2012 with the catalogue number 8288750. It contains two discs, one with ''[[M14|Black—Victini and Reshiram]]'' and the other with ''[[M14|White—Victini and Zekrom]]''. This set uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}, but does not include closed captioning. The promotional {{Trading Card Game}} card {{TCG ID|Next Destinies|Pikachu|39}} was included in early releases of the DVD. It was released both as a box set (containing individual DVD cases for each movie), as well as a single DVD case containing two discs. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Unova}} |border={{colorschemedark|Unova}} |image1=Pokémon the Movie Black and White 2 Movie Pack DVD prerelease.png |size1=x200px |caption1=Tentative cover image
used prior to release |image2=Pokémon the Movie Black and White 2 Movie Pack DVD.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Single DVD case cover |image3=Pokémon the Movie Black and White 2 Movie Pack box set.png |size3=x200px |caption3=Box set cover |image4=Black Victini and Reshiram DVD Region 2.png |size4=x200px |caption4=''Black—Victini and Reshiram'' cover |image5=White Victini and Zekrom DVD Region 2.png |size5=x200px |caption5=''White—Victini and Zekrom'' cover }} ===Pokémon Triple Movie Collection=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Aspect ratio, special features and whether it includes Pikachu shorts}} The Pokémon Triple Movie Collection DVD set was distributed by {{wp|StudioCanal}} in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 29, 2016 with the catalogue number MIROPD3086. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes ''[[M04|Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]'', ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]'', and ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]''. The collection was re-released on DVD under the name "Pokémon 3 Film Collection" in the United Kingdom in 2021 by {{wp|Paramount Home Entertainment}}, following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Pokémon Triple Movie Collection Region 2.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover (StudioCanal) |image2=Pokémon Triple Movie Collection Region 2 - Paramount.jpg |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover (Paramount) }} ===Pokémon Movie Collection=== {{incomplete|section|needs=DVD and regular Blu-Ray Catalogue number}} The Pokémon Movie Collection is a multi-movie set released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}}. It was released on Blu-ray in a Collector's Edition Steelbook and on DVD in the United Kingdom on November 14, 2016. It was released on Blu-ray in standard case in the United Kingdom on April 3, 2017. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'', ''[[M02|Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One]]'', and ''[[M03|Pokémon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. This set uses a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. The Steelbook’s catalog number is MANB8790. It includes ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'', ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'' and ''[[M13|Zoroark – Master of Illusions]]''. The Sword of Justice]]'' and ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. This is the very first UK DVD release for the latter. All the movies are shown in a {{wp|16:9}} {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}. ===Pokémon Movie Collection: XY=== Pokémon Movie Collection: XY is a multi-movie set that was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} on October 22, 2018 with the catalogue number MANG5898. It contains three discs, each containing a single movie. It features ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'', ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'' and ''[[M19|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]''. This is the very first UK DVD release for the former, while the other two are re-issues of their 2016 and 2017 releases respectively.
